obfuscation_indicators: customary covenants and events of default
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and generally transparent, with detailed reconciliations for revenue, margins, taxes, restructuring, acquisitions, and debt. Risk is mixed: revenue declined modestly and interest expense increased, while operating profit improved and debt maturities and covenant provisions are described. Extensive non-GAAP exclusions and dense presentation may make underlying performance and leverage somewhat harder to evaluate.
